interest: Wartime questions about making Japanese flags and the misuse of flag markings.
overview: Two dockets for 894.015: a 1944 inquiry on making Japanese flags and Grew's telegram on flag misuse.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers docket recording an inquiry by Walter J. Flannigan regarding regulations on the manufacture and mailing of Japanese flags.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Walter J. Flannigan's 1944 inquiry about rules on making and mailing Japanese flags.
subfiles.title: List of Papers on Japanese Flag Regulations

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers docket recording a telegram from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew concerning the misuse of Japanese flags and markings.
subfiles.summary: Docket: Grew's telegram No. 35 on Japan's attitude toward illegal use of its flag.
subfiles.title: List of Papers on Misuse of Japanese Flag and Markings
